rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=4, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=1500, lr=0.001, unet_c=32, rationale=iter-3 ONE-KNOB: unet_c 16->32 (per-domain SmallUNet denoiser capacity doubled in BOTH proj+img domains), all else held at iter-1/2; n_iter reset 800->400 (iter-1 value) to respect the <=15min wall now that each step is ~2-3x slower at c=32. HYPOTHESIS (denoiser-capacity-bound): iter-2 doubling n_iter 400->800 lifted val only 0.9501->0.9508 (+0.0007), so the per-scan Adam fit has CONVERGED -- n_iter is saturated and is NOT the lever. The 0.9508 plateau is therefore the c=16 SmallUNet's REPRESENTATIONAL ceiling, not a step-budget undershoot. Doubling unet_c 16->32 gives the per-image denoiser the expressive capacity to recover finer structure on each val scan's own measurements and should lift val above 0.9508. Wall: c=32 ~2-3x s/step; warm 3ep + 4 scenes x 400 steps capped by outer_wall_s=1500 (~<=15min). DO NOT revert to amortized; per-image N2I rewrite (commit 1f4c3394).
